#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::string str;
    std::cin >> str;
    
    std::vector<int> temp(n, 0);
    int count = 0;
    int k = 0;
    int flag = 0;
    
    if (str[0] == '_') {
        flag = 0;
    } else if (str[0] == '(') {
        flag = 1;
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (flag == 0) {
            if (str[i] == '_') {
                ++k;
            } else {
                if (str[i] != '(') {
                    temp[k]++;
                } else if (str[i] == '(') {
                    flag = 1;
                } else if (str[i] == ')') {
                    flag = 0;
                }
            }
        } else {
            if (str[i] == ')') {
                flag = 0;
                ++k;
            } else if (i > 0) {
                if (str[i-1] == '(' || str[i-1] == '_') {
                    if (str[i] != '_' && str[i] != '(') {
                        ++count;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    std::sort(temp.begin(), temp.end(), std::greater<int>());
    
    std::cout << temp[0] << std::endl;
    std::cout << count << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
